title: A shared exchange

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The schematic shows photosynthetic partners inside coral tissue and an arrow toward the animal for food products. The animal can supply materials including carbon dioxide. This is a simplified exchange, not a complete account of every coral association.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: In a simplified coral–algae partnership, what can photosynthetic partners provide to the coral animal?

claims.text: Two partners can exchange resources. In a simplified coral–algae partnership, what can photosynthetic partners provide to the coral animal?
